locations.note: Ezio rebuilds the Assassin Brotherhood in Borgia-ruled Rome during the Italian Wars of 1500-1507.
The Auditore villa town where the game opens, before a Borgia siege drives Ezio to Rome.
Ezio hides the Apple in a First Civilization vault beneath the Colosseum.
The Pantheon is one of the Roman landmarks Ezio climbs.
Ezio breaks into the Borgia stronghold to free Caterina Sforza, who is held prisoner in the castle.
Ezio retrieves the Apple from within St. Peter's Basilica.
The finale in 1507: Ezio follows Cesare Borgia to Viana in Navarre and ends him on the castle walls.
Ezio's travels take him to the harbour of Naples.

routes.name: Ezio against the Borgia
routes.note: The siege of Monteriggioni, the years in Rome, and the chase after Cesare to Spain.
